iti49:2.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave diṭṭhi-gatehi pariyuṭṭhitā devamanussā oliyanti eke atidhāvanti eke cakkhumanto ca passanti.
iti49:3.2: Bhavārāmā bhikkhave devamanussā bhavaratā bhavasammuditā, tesaṃ bhavanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati,
iti49:4.2: Bhaveneva kho paneke aṭṭiyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā vibhavaṃ abhinandanti.
iti49:4.3: Yato kira bho ayaṃ attho kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param-maraṇā,
iti49:4.4: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ etaṃ yathāvan-ti,
iti49:5.3: bhūtaṃ bhūtato disvā bhūtassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti,
iti49:8.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||12||
